result.summary: The page is generally well-designed, but there is one minor visual anomaly related to how a zero-value discount is displayed.

issues.description: A discount badge on the partially visible pizza card at the bottom displays '-0%', which is a confusing and illogical value to show to a user.
issues.suggestion: Hide the discount badge entirely when the discount value is 0%, or change the logic so it only displays for positive values (e.g., '-10%').
